user.title: Connect to Kstar Inverter (RS485)
user.description: Configure your USB-to-RS485 adapter and Modbus address. Ensure the inverter's 485 protocol is set to MODBUS (1).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Kstar inverter over RS485. Verify wiring, baud rate, slave ID, and that the inverter protocol is set to MODBUS.
